rationale: This inscription is a fragment of a Rhodian amphora stamp found at Tel Istabah in Skythopolis (Beth Shean). The letters '[ ]νε' and '[ ]ς' are likely the remains of a Greek name, either of the manufacturer or the eponymous magistrate of Rhodes. Such stamps were ubiquitous in the Hellenistic Levant as markers of trade and administrative control.
